displayedInputs.question:
Let \(AB\) be a diameter of a circle and \(C\) be a point on \(AB\) with \(2 \cdot AC = BC.\) Let \(D\) and \(E\) be points on the circle such that \(DC \perp AB\) and \(DE\) is a second diameter. What is the ratio of the area of \(\triangle DCE\) to the area of \(\triangle ABD?\)

[Figure 1](attached-image-1)

Three circles of radius \(s\) are drawn in the first quadrant of the \(xy\)-plane. The first circle is tangent to both axes, the second is tangent to the first circle and the \(x\)-axis, and the third is tangent to the first circle and the \(y\)-axis. A circle of radius \(r \gt s\) is tangent to both axes and to the second and third circles. What is \(\frac{r}{s}?\)

[Figure 1](attached-image-2)

A unit cube is cut twice to form three triangular prisms, two of which are congruent, as shown in Figure \(1.\) The cube is then cut in the same manner along the dashed lines shown in Figure \(2.\) This creates nine pieces. What is the volume of the piece that contains vertex \(W?\)

[Figure 1](attached-image-3)

An \(8\)-foot by \(10\)-foot floor is tiled with square tiles of size \(1\) foot by \(1\) foot. Each tile has a pattern consisting of four white quarter circles of radius \(\dfrac12\) foot centered at each corner of the tile. The remaining portion of the tile is shaded. How many square feet of the floor are shaded?

[Figure 1](attached-image-4)

What is the minimum number of small squares that must be shaded so that a line of symmetry lies on the diagonal \(\overline{BD}\) of square \(ABCD\)?

[Figure 1](attached-image-5)

In quadrilateral \(ABCD,\) sides \(\overline{AB}\) and \(\overline{BC}\) both have length \(10,\) sides \(\overline{CD}\) and \(\overline{DA}\) both have length \(17,\) and the measure of angle \(ADC\) is \(60^\circ.\) What is the length of diagonal \(\overline{AC}?\)

[Figure 1](attached-image-6)

The area of polygon \(ABCDEF\) is \(52\) with \(AB=8,\) \(BC=9\) and \(FA=5.\) What is \(DE+EF?\)

[Figure 1](attached-image-7)

The results of a cross-country team’s training run are graphed below. Which student has the greatest average speed?

[Figure 1](attached-image-8)
